Method of Attack: Exploitation of a security flaw in Oracle Micros point-of-sale systems allowing attackers to collect configuration files, gain full legitimate access to POS systems and attached services, and install POS malware to steal payment card details or conduct corporate espionage
Remote exploitation via crafted HTTP requests
Local network exploitation through compromised internal systems
Physical access attack by connecting a malicious Raspberry Pi device to the POS system
Attack Vector: Local network relay via compromised systems
Physical connection of malicious device in store
